biotools.summary: KDepoCaps is a machine learning-based predictor for identifying Klebsiella pneumoniae capsule types of phage depolymerases using protein language model-derived protein sequence embeddings.

documentation.note: KDepoCaps documentation, installation instructions, and usage examples are available at the GitHub repository.

function.cmd: python KDepoCaps.py -i proteins.fasta -esm esmc_300m_2024_12_v0.pth -pm protein_model.joblib -o rediction.csv
function.note: Predict Klebsiella pneumoniae capsule types of phage depolymerases using protein language model embeddings and machine learning models.

biotools.name: KDepoCaps
